DO $$ 
DECLARE
    v_row_count INT;
    v_child_count INT; -- 추가된 변수: child 건수 저장용
BEGIN
    SET search_path TO "META_ADF", public;
    -- 1. 첫 번째 단일 INSERT 실행 (마스터 러닝 생성)
    INSERT INTO ctl_master_pipeline_run (
        master_run_id,
        master_pipeline_nm,
        trigger_id,
        trigger_nm,
        ingest_type,
        start_dt,
        exec_group, 
        created_by,
        status,
        run_mode
    ) VALUES (
        '@{pipeline().RunId}',
        '@{pipeline().Pipeline}',                     
        '@{pipeline().TriggerId}',                         
        '@{pipeline().TriggerName}',                   
        CASE
                WHEN '@{pipeline().parameters.P_INIT_WAIT_YN}' = 'Y'
                  THEN 'FULL'
               ELSE '@{variables('v_ingest_type')}'
            END, 
        CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,  
        '',
        'ADF',                           
        'PENDING',                                     
        CASE 
            WHEN '@{pipeline().TriggerType}' = 'Manual' THEN 'MANUAL' 
            ELSE 'SCHEDULE' 
        END                                             
    );

    -- 첫 번째 INSERT 실행 결과 확인
    GET DIAGNOSTICS v_row_count = ROW_COUNT;

    -- 2. 첫 번째 INSERT가 성공(1건 이상 반영)했을 경우에만 다음 작업 수행
    IF v_row_count > 0 THEN
        RAISE NOTICE '첫 번째 INSERT 성공. %건 반영됨. 다음 작업을 진행합니다.', v_row_count;
        
        -- 3. INSERT ... SELECT 실행 (하위 인제스트 러닝 생성)
        INSERT INTO ctl_ingest_pipeline_run (
            ingest_pipeline_id,
            master_run_id,
            master_pipeline_nm,
            target_id,
            src_type,
            src_db_nm,
            src_schema_nm,
            src_table_nm,
            data_class,
            ingest_type,
            exec_group,
            condition_type,
            condition_frequency,
            condition_interval,
            incr_column_nm,
            incr_column_type,
            incr_column_hw_val,
            incr_start_val,
            init_wait_yn,
            extract_query,
            landing_path,
            status,
            created_by,
            created_dt
        )
       SELECT
            gen_random_uuid()::text,
            '@{pipeline().RunId}',
            '@{pipeline().Pipeline}',
            t.target_id,
            t.src_type,
            t.src_db_nm,
            t.src_schema_nm,
            t.src_table_nm,
            t.data_class,
            CASE
                WHEN '@{pipeline().parameters.P_INIT_WAIT_YN}' = 'Y'
                  THEN 'FULL'
               ELSE t.ingest_type
            END,
            t.exec_group,
            t.condition_type,
            t.condition_frequency,
            t.condition_interval,
            t.incr_column_nm,
            t.incr_column_type,
            t.incr_column_hw_val,
            '@{variables('v_start_dt')}',
            t.init_wait_yn,
            CASE t.src_type
            ---------------- DB2 ----------------
            WHEN 'DB2' THEN
                format('select * from %s.%s where %s fetch first 1 rows only with ur ;',
                    t.src_schema_nm, t.src_table_nm,
                    CASE
                      WHEN t.init_wait_yn = 'Y' OR t.ingest_type = 'FULL' THEN '1=1'
                      WHEN t.ingest_type = 'INCR' THEN
                        t.incr_column_nm || ' >= ' ||
                        CASE t.incr_column_type
                          WHEN 'DATE'      THEN 'DATE('      || quote_literal('@{variables('v_start_dt')}') || ')'
                          WHEN 'TIMESTAMP' THEN 'TIMESTAMP(' || quote_literal('@{variables('v_start_dt')}') || ')'
                          WHEN 'STRING'    THEN                quote_literal('@{variables('v_start_dt')}')
                        END
                    END)
            ---------------- MS-SQL ----------------
            WHEN 'MS-SQL' THEN
                format('SELECT * FROM [%s].[%s] WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE %s;',
                    t.src_schema_nm, t.src_table_nm,
                    CASE
                      WHEN t.init_wait_yn = 'Y' OR t.ingest_type = 'FULL' THEN '1=1'
                      WHEN t.ingest_type = 'INCR' THEN
                        '[' || t.incr_column_nm || '] >= ' ||
                        CASE t.incr_column_type
                          WHEN 'DATE'      THEN 'CAST(' || quote_literal('@{variables('v_start_dt')}') || ' AS DATE)'
                          WHEN 'TIMESTAMP' THEN 'CAST(' || quote_literal('@{variables('v_start_dt')}') || ' AS DATETIME2)'
                          WHEN 'STRING'    THEN            quote_literal('@{variables('v_start_dt')}')
                        END
                    END)
            ---------------- Azure COSMOS ----------------
            WHEN 'COSMOS' THEN
                CASE
                  WHEN t.init_wait_yn = 'Y' OR t.ingest_type = 'FULL'
                    THEN 'SELECT * FROM c'
                  WHEN t.ingest_type = 'INCR'
                    THEN format('SELECT * FROM c WHERE c.%s >= %s',
                           t.incr_column_nm,
                           quote_literal('@{variables('v_start_dt')}'))
              END
             else '-'
            END AS extract_query,
            '@{variables('v_landing_path')}',
            'PENDING',
            'ADF',
            CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        FROM ctl_ingest_target_master t
        WHERE t.delete_yn = 'N'
          AND t.data_class = '@{variables('v_data_class')}'
          AND CASE
                WHEN '@{pipeline().parameters.P_INIT_WAIT_YN}' = 'Y'
                  THEN (t.init_wait_yn = 'Y')
                ELSE (t.ingest_type = '@{variables('v_ingest_type')}' AND t.init_wait_yn = 'N')
              END;

        -- 4. INSERT ... SELECT 건수 확인
        GET DIAGNOSTICS v_child_count = ROW_COUNT;

        -- 5. ctl_master_pipeline_run 의 child_total_cnt 업데이트
        UPDATE ctl_master_pipeline_run
           SET child_total_cnt = v_child_count ,
		       update_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
			   update_by = 'ADF' 
         WHERE master_run_id = '@{pipeline().RunId}';

        RAISE NOTICE 'INSERT ... SELECT 완료. child_total_cnt(%건) 업데이트 완료.', v_child_count;

    ELSE
        RAISE NOTICE '첫 번째 INSERT가 반영되지 않았습니다. 다음 작업을 건너뜁니다.';
    END IF;

EXCEPTION 
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        RAISE NOTICE '오류가 발생하여 모든 작업이 롤백되었습니다. 오류 메시지: %', SQLERRM;
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Transaction failed: %', SQLERRM;
END $$;
